## Change objective
What hypothesis, contract or problem does this change address?

## Alternatives
What simpler baseline or competing mechanism was considered?

## Evidence
Commands executed, dataset/split, hardware, artifacts, result and uncertainty (no invented results).

Identify the exact submitted subject: task specification, candidate, protocol, evaluator, inputs, environment, and analysis where relevant. Link the canonical records. Keep routine-fix evidence proportionate and explain unused dimensions instead of inventing experiments.

## Risks and review
Failure modes, counterexamples, test/contract changes and remaining unknowns.

Identify shared-resource conflicts and outstanding external effects. State whether the final integrated candidate was checked when changes can interact. Project status, CI labels, and reviewer-name strings do not grant acceptance authority.

## Adoption decision
Implementation accepted != hypothesis validated. State the distinction.
